behaviors.behavior: Offline ingest accepts local JSON objects, JSON arrays, events objects, and JSONL streams.
Ingest recursively redacts known token shapes and secret-named fields before persistence.
Unclassified high-entropy values, including GitHub provenance URL query values and path payloads, fail closed with exit 6 before any experience shard is written.
GitHub provenance URL path entropy scanning runs before the URL-shape exemption, including tokens appended after normal PR paths.
GitHub provenance URL paths containing raw slash-bearing, percent-encoded slash-bearing, or short-middle-fragment high-entropy token payloads fail closed before persistence.
Clean GitHub provenance URLs, including large PR-number paths, continue to ingest without false-positive redaction failure.
Canonical experience records preserve PR attribution, provenance URLs, confidence labels, signatures, flake discount, private share scope, and org_eligible false.
Experience persistence is idempotent and monthly-sharded under .relia/experiences/YYYY-MM.jsonl.
